method: Multimodal visual inspection of full-size contact-sheet images using view_image; not a human study or model benchmark trial.
scope: Sampled clear train, occluded/sheared transfer, and high-noise/partial/offscreen diagnostic panels.
initial_finding: The pre-final overview footer was too long for its card. The exporter now uses a shorter caption and validates text width.
final_findings: Labels fit their cards; no observed clipping or overlap in reviewed final sheets.
Overview pairs show the same shutter and visible background; inspection reveals changed target location.
Landmark and object colors remain distinguishable in inspected examples.
Half-object diagnostic panels visibly expose half the target and report nonzero centroid bias.
Offscreen auxiliary circles are visibly clipped as intended; these are explicitly diagnostic examples.
limitations: Only these 3 of the21 sheets were visually inspected by this reviewer.
Automated byte and geometry checks cover all336 observation images; that is a separate evidence channel.
This does not establish human perceptual difficulty or natural-image model performance.
